name: titpetric/refinement
description: Refine a design through a thread of comments, each one a Claude run
comment: Where lib/MiniTPL came from. Nothing installs this: a module ships inside the task-ui binary and the Go module proxy drops a vendor directory, so the sources are copied into lib/MiniTPL and index.php names them. To take a new release, composer update in a scratch directory and copy code/MiniTPL over lib/MiniTPL.
